name: @web3-starter/contracts
description: Hardhat 3 project using Node Test Runner and viem

scripts.deploy: hardhat ignition deploy ignition/modules/Gattai.ts --network hardhatMainnet --parameters ignition/parameters/local.json
scripts.deploy:testnet: node --env-file=.env ../node_modules/hardhat/dist/src/cli.js ignition deploy ignition/modules/Gattai.ts --network robinhoodTestnet --parameters ignition/parameters/testnet.json
scripts.deploy:usdg:testnet: node --env-file=.env ../node_modules/hardhat/dist/src/cli.js ignition deploy ignition/modules/MockUsdg.ts --network robinhoodTestnet --parameters ignition/parameters/testnet.json
scripts.deploy:phase1:testnet: node --env-file=.env ../node_modules/hardhat/dist/src/cli.js ignition deploy ignition/modules/DepositManager.ts --network robinhoodTestnet --parameters ignition/parameters/testnet.json
scripts.deploy:phase1:mainnet: node ../node_modules/hardhat/dist/src/cli.js ignition deploy ignition/modules/DepositManager.ts --network robinhood --parameters ignition/parameters/mainnet.json
scripts.deploy:token:mainnet: node ../node_modules/hardhat/dist/src/cli.js ignition deploy ignition/modules/GattaiToken.ts --network robinhood --parameters ignition/parameters/token-mainnet.json
scripts.deploy:full:mainnet: node ../node_modules/hardhat/dist/src/cli.js ignition deploy ignition/modules/Gattai.ts --network robinhood --parameters ignition/parameters/mainnet.json
